name: Solar Prism Waterfall
description: A massive waterfall cascading through a canyon of natural prisms, splitting sunlight into vivid ribbons that paint the mist with rainbows.
prompt: Epic wide-angle view of a towering waterfall flowing through a canyon lined with giant crystalline prisms. Sunlight hits the prisms, refracting into brilliant spectral bands that illuminate the mist and surrounding rock walls. Hyper-realistic, ultra-high detail, 8K, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, sense of scale with tiny human silhouettes at the base.
caption: When light learns to dance with water 🌈💧 #NatureMagic
